name: Baal-perazim
line: Baal-perazim was a place near the valley of Rephaim where David defeated the Philistines, and he named it for the way God burst out against his enemies.

moments.title: A bursting flood
moments.text: David went to Baal-perazim and defeated the Philistines. He said the LORD had burst out against his enemies like a bursting flood, so he named the place Baal-perazim.

moments.title: Idols left behind
moments.text: The Philistines abandoned their idols there. David and his men carried them away, and David ordered that they be burned in the fire.
